# authwise_realm_config (Data Source)

A realm's config: provisioning, recovery, bot protection, SMS and the default locale. The authentication policy is not part of it: declare an `authwise_realm_authentication_policy`. Builds the RealmConfig message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_realm.config` takes. Makes no API calls.

When a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, Terraform reads this data source at apply rather than at plan, even though every argument is known: `json` shows as (known after apply), and `authwise_realm.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op when nothing else changed. The function `provider::authwise::realm_config` takes the same arguments as an object, returns the same string, and is evaluated at plan: use it to keep those plans quiet (Terraform 1.8 or later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "authwise_realm_config" "this" {
  default_locale = "en"

  provisioning = {
    self_signup                = true
    require_email_verification = true
  }

  recovery = {
    self_service_reset = true
    reset_ttl          = "30m"
  }

  bot_protection = {
    mode       = "ALWAYS"
    provider   = "TURNSTILE"
    site_key   = "0x4AAAAAAA"
    secret_ref = { name = authwise_secret.turnstile.name }
  }
}

resource "authwise_realm" "this" {
  display_name = "Customers"
  config       = data.authwise_realm_config.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bot_protection` (Attributes) The challenge an anonymous request must pass before kit sends mail or SMS or creates an account. Absent is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bot_protection))
- `default_locale` (String) The BCP 47 tag the realm writes to its people in when nothing better is known. Unset is no realm default, which is not the same as `en`.
- `provisioning` (Attributes) How an account comes to exist in the realm. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning))
- `recovery` (Attributes) Whether a person may reset a forgotten password from the login page, and how long the link lives. Absent is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recovery))
- `sms` (Attributes) Where the realm will send an SMS, and how many per destination prefix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sms))

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of RealmConfig, for `authwise_realm.config`.

<a id="nestedatt--bot_protection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bot_protection`

Optional:

- `endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint serving AuthwiseBotCheckService, for `ENDPOINT`.
- `fail_mode` (String)
- `mode` (String) `OFF` (the default), `ALWAYS`, or `ADAPTIVE`, which kit refuses for now.
- `provider` (String)
- `refuse_disposable_signup` (Boolean)
- `secret_ref` (Attributes) The provider's secret key, for `TURNSTILE` and `HCAPTCHA`, as `{ name = authwise_secret.x.name }`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bot_protection--secret_ref))
- `site_key` (String) The provider's public key, rendered by the login UI.
- `timeout` (String) A Go duration string, e.g. `90s`, `15m`, `12h`.

<a id="nestedatt--bot_protection--secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bot_protection.secret_ref`

Optional:

- `name` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--provisioning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning`

Optional:

- `admin_direct` (Boolean) Not yet supported: no kit build acts on it, so kit refuses it set; it awaits an admin-direct credential surface.
- `admin_set_permanent_password` (Boolean) Not yet supported: no kit build acts on it, so kit refuses it set; it rides `admin_direct`, which has no surface yet.
- `allowed_provider_types` (List of String) Not yet supported: no kit build acts on it, so kit refuses it set; it awaits the per-realm provider policy surface (kit#222).
- `invitation_ttl` (String) A Go duration string, e.g. `90s`, `15m`, `12h`.
- `invitations` (Boolean)
- `jit_federated` (Boolean)
- `password_hash_spec` (String)
- `password_rule_set` (String) The catalog set of password rules the realm follows (kit#890). Unset or empty is `authwise-baseline`; `authwise-strict` is the baseline at 15 characters plus a breached-password check and the last 5 passwords refused (kit#886); `custom` is kit's built-in floor plus `password_validators` alone; any other value must name a set the kit build ships, or kit refuses the write at apply. A name, never a version: a shipped set only strengthens, and only passwords set after a change are checked against it.
- `password_validators` (Attributes List) The realm's own password rules. With a catalog set they are extras that can only tighten it, merged per type with the strongest winning: the larger `min_length`, the smaller `max_length`, and every `regexp` and `entropy` rule kept. Under `custom` they are the whole policy above the built-in floor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--password_validators))
- `provisioning_integration_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--provisioning_integration_config))
- `require_email_verification` (Boolean)
- `scim` (Boolean) Not yet supported: no kit build acts on it, so kit refuses it set; it awaits an inbound SCIM channel (kit#192).
- `self_signup` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--password_validators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.password_validators`

Optional:

- `config` (String) The validator's settings, as JSON: `jsonencode({ min = 12 })`. A JSON object, e.g. from `jsonencode`.
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) `min_length` (config `min`, at least 8), `max_length` (config `max`, 64 to 256), `regexp` (config `pattern` and `no_match_message`) or `entropy` (config `min_entropy_bits`).


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--provisioning_integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.provisioning_integration_config`

Optional:

- `endpoint_name` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--recovery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recovery`

Optional:

- `reset_ttl` (String) A Go duration string, e.g. `90s`, `15m`, `12h`.
- `self_service_reset` (Boolean)
- `support_contact` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--sms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sms`

Optional:
